A '''sonic dishwasher''' a device for [[Dishwasher/Legends|cleaning dishes]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had a sonic dishwasher installed in his [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|hut]] on the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
